title: Third SLA focus row's hit rect overlaps the bottom tray chips' top 4px — ui_press swallows tray chip presses
detail: Line 2's rect spans y win_h-50..win_h-32; tray chips span win_h-36..win_h-10. In the 4px overlap (x 332..748 at 1280w, 6 chips), on_ui_press's sla_focus_click returns true first, so Select_Tier/Arm_Placement never fire and the class focus toggles instead.
recommended_fix: Clamp the hit rect's bottom above the tray (height 14, or y..y+16 matching the text), or test tray_chip_rect before sla_focus_click in the press order.

title: Crisis banner + SLA row rects joined the press-side hit-test but not the release-side — a straddling click selects through the chrome
detail: A press just outside the banner/row rect released inside it (≤6px move, so `moved` is false and press_swallowed is unset) passes release_ui_hit and click_selects — then focus-zooms — a node under the new chrome.
recommended_fix: Add the crisis_banner_rect and the sla_row_rects to effect_ui_release (the 5.5 release-side swallow, like popover/QoS/tray) so releases inside them never click-select.
